subject: SOC2 renewal due diligence — log window & burst credit request
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 renewal — evidence timeline & capacity credit ask

Hi Marissa / Ben,

As we prepare to kick off our renewal for Q3, procurement asked me to consolidate a few items so we can land a PO by the end of June. High level: Acme is comfortable renewing, but we need clarity on the SOC2 re-attestation evidence process, options for longer log retention during the 12‑month renewal term, and whether Redwood can offer a one-time credit for the added cost of temporary burst capacity during our planned migration window.

Can you confirm:
- The expected deliverables and format for SOC2 evidence (control mappings, redacted logs, screen recordings if needed) and a proposed upload cadence.
- Retention windows you support (90/180/365) and approximate incremental cost for our current average ingest (~2.5 TB/month).
- Details on burst capacity pricing and whether Redwood will provide a short-term credit if we commit to a 12‑month renewal with a modest upsell (we're targeting +20% capacity).

We'd like to get a draft statement of work / amendment and a ballpark price by next Wednesday (May 26) so procurement can route internally. Also looping in our external auditor, Sam Leigh (cc), who may request a contact on your security team for a quick scope sync.

Thanks — let me know if a 30‑minute call early next week would help.

Best,
Elena
Director, Security & Compliance
Acme Cloud

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sam Leigh <sam.leigh@auditpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal — evidence timeline & capacity credit ask

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to support the renewal path and can meet the May 26 internal milestone with a scoped amendment and options. Quick summary / proposal: 

1) Evidence & cadence:
- Deliverables: control mapping spreadsheet, redacted log bundles (CSV/NDJSON per control), a handful of redacted screenshots for configuration (when required), and a short narrative of our control changes since last attestation.
- Format: we’ll publish artifacts into a shared Drive folder (link below) and provide a one‑page evidence index (CSV) for auditor consumption.
- Cadence: staggered uploads over 2 weeks to reduce pressure on your ingest window; final consolidated handoff at least 2 weeks before your auditor kickoff.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bz-acme-soc2-evidence

2) Retention windows & pricing (rough):
- 90 days: no change to current baseline (included).
- 180 days: incremental $0.08/GB/month on retained logs.
- 365 days: incremental $0.14/GB/month on retained logs.
Estimates based on your ~2.5TB/month ingest -> rough incremental monthly cost: 180d ~$200, 365d ~$350. We'll include line items in the SOW.

3) Burst capacity & credit:
- Burst model: on-demand burst at 1.5x baseline available; metered by token/throughput minutes.
- Proposal: 1) grant a one-time credit equal to 50% of the projected burst invoice for the first 30 days if you commit to the 12‑month renewal and agree to a +20% reserved capacity uplift.
- We'll validate the projection in the final quote.

Next steps: Ben will draft a short amendment + pricing sheet. Can we schedule a 30‑minute sync on Tue 5/25 at 10am PT? If that works for Sam as auditor contact, we can loop him in briefly.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal — evidence timeline & capacity credit ask

Elena — following up from Marissa's note and our 5/25 sync. Here are the concrete pricing options and the draft credit structure I mentioned on the call. I'll attach the workbook snapshot as well.

Retention pricing (incremental, per month):
- 90d: $0/GB (baseline)
- 180d: $0.08/GB -> for 2.5TB/month => ~$200/month incremental
- 365d: $0.14/GB -> for 2.5TB/month => ~$350/month incremental

Burst capacity pricing (metered):
- Metering unit: peak throughput minutes (PTM).
- Typical burst for migration (4‑6 weeks) estimate: 18k PTM -> normally ~$7,200 for period.

Credit proposal:
- One-time credit equal to 50% of the estimated burst charge for the first 30 days (applies only if Acme: a) signs 12‑month renewal, and b) commits to +20% reserved capacity upfront).
- If actual burst utilization materially differs (>30% variance), we’ll reconcile on the final invoice.

Operational notes for the security handoff:
- We will curate redaction patterns and produce a manifest for each log bundle.
- Karthik: can you confirm if we should include the full KV-cache controls export or a summarized configuration snapshot for the auditor?

Attachments: capacity-credits-workbook.xlsx (pricing model snapshot), SOC2-evidence-index.csv (evidence index starter)

Thanks — happy to formalize into an amendment tonight and send a DocuSign link to procurement.

Cheers,
Ben
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmecloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Leigh <sam.leigh@auditpartners.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 renewal — evidence timeline & capacity credit ask

Thanks Ben / Marissa — that all looks reasonable and addresses procurement's questions. A few quick items before we proceed to signature: 

1) Auditor contact: Sam, please confirm whether the proposed staggered handoff (2 weeks) and artifact formats work for you. If so, we expect to lock the audit window the week of July 12.
2) Legal amendment: Procurement asks that Redwood include a short attestation addendum stating Redwood will provide redacted evidence and maintain chain-of-custody logs for the handoff. Please route the amendment to procurement@acmecloud.com and cc me.
3) DocuSign + quote: Can you send a formal quote and DocuSign for the amendment so we can start routing internally?

If we get the DocuSign by EOD Monday we should be fine to route for signature and hit our June PO cutoff. Appreciate the flexibility on the burst credit — that was an important factor for finance.

Best,
Elena
Director, Security & Compliance
Acme Cloud
